dialogue.origin: (こんばんは。ロールプレイは可能でしょうか？)
dialogue.content: (Good evening. Is it possible to do a role-play?)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: 遅くなりすみません。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for the delay.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Not at all. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: はじめに、年齢、性別、相談したいことを教えてください
dialogue.content: First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 25才女性恋愛相談です。
dialogue.content: I am a 25-year-old woman, and I'd like to talk about a relationship issue.

dialogue.origin: 恋愛相談ですね。彼氏さんとの関係でしょうか?
dialogue.content: A relationship issue, I see. Is it about your relationship with your boyfriend?

dialogue.origin: はい。今、会えなくて。でも、ハッキリ理由がわからないというか、不可解なんです。
dialogue.content: Yes. We can't see each other right now. But I don't really know the reason clearly—it feels puzzling.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただいてありがとうございます。不可解、という言葉はドキリとしますね。悩んでらつしゃるのが伝わってきます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. The word 'puzzling' is striking. I can tell this is weighing on you.

dialogue.origin: どのように不可解な感じなのか、もう少し詳しく教えてもらってもいいですか
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about what makes it feel puzzling?

dialogue.origin: はい、今までは週一くらいで会っていたのに、急に家族の病気がわかり、ショックだから、会えない、みたいに。それもLINEだけで。電話にもでないのです。おかしくないですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. We used to see each other about once a week, but suddenly he found out a family member is sick, and he said he's in shock and can't see me. And he only told me this over LINE. He won't even answer his phone. Don't you think that's strange?

dialogue.origin: 会えないだけではなくて、電話にも出なくて連絡も取れない、という状況なんですね。
dialogue.content: So, it's not just that you can't see him, but he also won't answer his phone, and you can't get in touch with him.

dialogue.origin: それも急な変化だから、「おかしい」と感じているんですね
dialogue.content: And because it's such a sudden change, it feels 'strange' to you.

dialogue.origin: 先週まで一応LINEには応えていたのですが、今はもう、既読スルーです。
dialogue.content: Until last week, he was at least responding on LINE, but now he just leaves my messages on "read."

dialogue.origin: 1週間くらい既読スルーが続いているんですね。
dialogue.content: So he's been leaving your messages on "read" for about a week now.

dialogue.origin: 今ままでの親密さを考えると、それは気になりますね
dialogue.content: Given the closeness you've had, that's understandably concerning.

dialogue.origin: はい。私は詳しく今は彼がどんな大変な状況かしり、支えになりたいと思っているのに。
dialogue.content: Yes. I want to know the details of the difficult situation he's in right now so I can be there to support him.

dialogue.origin: 私は結婚も考えてもいたし、彼も家族に会ってもらいたい、くらいの話が出ていたのに。
dialogue.content: I had been thinking about marriage, and he had even talked about wanting me to meet his family.

dialogue.origin: 家族が大変なときに、会えない、の一点張りでした。
dialogue.content: But when his family is going through a hard time, he was insistent that he can't see me.

dialogue.origin: 彼氏さんのご家族にも会っているほどの関係なんですね。それで病気のことも心配して、支えになりたいと。
dialogue.content: So your relationship is at the point where you were going to meet his family. And so you're worried about the illness and want to support him.

dialogue.origin: まだ家族にはあってません。これからの予定です。
dialogue.content: I haven't met his family yet. That was the plan for the future.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。これから会う予定だったんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You were planning to meet them.

dialogue.origin: はい。そんな感じの付き合いで、なぜ、会えなくなるのかわからなくて。
dialogue.content: Yes. Given that kind of relationship, I don't understand why we suddenly can't meet.

dialogue.origin: 結婚を考える相手なら、支え合いたいというお気持ちは自然で優しいですね。
dialogue.content: If he's someone you're considering marriage with, your wish to support each other is natural and kind.

dialogue.origin: 支えになりたい、というお気持ちは彼氏さんに伝えましたか?
dialogue.content: Have you told your boyfriend that you want to be there for him?

dialogue.origin: 家族が病気なら支えになりたいのは、自然ですよね。気持ちはLINEで伝えましたが、こんな大変な時には、会えないだけしかかえってきません。噛み合わないんです。
dialogue.content: It's natural to want to offer support if his family is sick, right? I told him how I feel over LINE, but all he says back is that he can't see me during this difficult time. We're not on the same page.

dialogue.origin: まるで私と会うのが家族にとって後ろめたいとでも思ってるのでしょうか。もしくは他に好きな人ができたとか。
dialogue.content: It's like he feels it would be something to feel guilty about toward his family if he met with me. Or maybe he's found someone else.

dialogue.origin: 支えたいのも、家族を心配するのも自然な気持ちですよ。
dialogue.content: It's natural to want to support him and to be concerned for his family.

dialogue.origin: 「後ろめたい」というのは、家族が病気なのに彼女と会うなんて、という意味でしょうか? 他に気になっていることがあるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: When you say 'guilty,' do you mean he might feel bad about seeing his girlfriend while his family is sick? Is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 後ろめたい、その通りです。そしてもしくは他に好きな人ができたのではと。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's exactly what I mean by guilty. And also, that he might have found someone else he likes.

dialogue.origin: 病気の重さ・深刻さはわからないですが、そういった「後ろめたさ」からいつもと違う行動になっている可能性もありますね
dialogue.content: We don't know the severity or seriousness of the illness, but it's possible that this feeling of 'guilt' is causing him to act differently than usual.

dialogue.origin: 「他に好きな人」ができたのでは、という不安も、今の状況では抱えてしまいやすいですよね
dialogue.content: And the fear that he might have 'found someone else' is also an easy one to have in this situation.

dialogue.origin: 後ろめたさ、はやはり私という存在は軽かったということでしょうか。
dialogue.content: If it's guilt, does that mean I wasn't that important to him after all?

dialogue.origin: あと、以前同じ職場でしたが、２ヶ月前に私が転職して付き合いがはじまりました。
dialogue.content: Also, we used to work at the same place, but I changed jobs two months ago, and that's when we started dating.

dialogue.origin: なので、以前の職場の人は私知っていて、その中のこと仲良くなったのではとうたがってしまいます。
dialogue.content: So, people at my old workplace know me, and I can't help but suspect he might have gotten close to someone there.

dialogue.origin: 付き合って2ヶ月なんですね。それで連絡が取れなければ、いろいろ考えたり疑ったりしてしまうのも自然だと思いますよ
dialogue.content: So you've been dating for two months. If he's not in contact, I think it's natural to have all these thoughts and suspicions.

dialogue.origin: いろいろな不安がありますが、現状でできることで、まずはどうなったらいいと思いますか?
dialogue.content: You have many worries, but considering what's possible in the current situation, what would you like to see happen first?

dialogue.origin: まずは、会ってはなしたい。でも、向こうは返事もしない。もうお手上げな感じです。
dialogue.content: First, I want to meet and talk. But he won't even reply. I feel like my hands are tied.

dialogue.origin: LINEだけだと埒が明かないから。
dialogue.content: Because just using LINE gets us nowhere.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり会いたいですよね。でも、現状は返事もなくて。辛いですね。
dialogue.content: You really want to see him, don't you? But right now, there's no reply. That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: はい、もうどうしたらいいか、わからにいんです。
dialogue.content: Yes, I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: やはり隠していることがあれから、会えないのかと考えてしまいます。
dialogue.content: I can't help but think he's hiding something, and that's why he can't see me.

dialogue.origin: 会いたいのに、会えない、というのが、やはり一番の辛さなんですね。
dialogue.content: So wanting to see him but not being able to is the hardest part for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、会ってはなせたら、何もかも明らかになるのではないかと。
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like if we could just meet and talk, everything would become clear.

dialogue.origin: 会えない・連絡をくれない中でできる事を一緒に考えてみませんか
dialogue.content: Shall we think together about what you can do while you can't see him or get a reply?

dialogue.origin: はい、なにかあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, is there anything I can do?

dialogue.origin: できることなんて。
dialogue.content: Is there anything I can even do?

dialogue.origin: すぐ解決できないのはしんどいかも知れませんが、自分はちゃんと彼氏さんと向き合おうとしている、という主体的な気持ちを持つのはどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: It might be hard that it can't be resolved quickly, but how about holding onto the proactive mindset that you're properly trying to face your boyfriend?

dialogue.origin: 主体的な気持ち、とは、なんでしょうか…。すみません、よくわからなくて。
dialogue.content: 'A proactive mindset,' what does that mean...? I'm sorry, I don't really understand.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ちょっと専門用語だつたかも知れません。「主体的」というのは、「自分を意思を持って」という感じのイメージです。彼氏さんの事情はどうであれ、辛い状況に流されずに、自分はどうしたいか、という気持ちを大事にしてもらいたいと思いました
dialogue.content: You're right, that might have been a bit of jargon. 'Proactive' has the sense of 'acting with your own will.' Whatever your boyfriend's situation is, I wanted to encourage you not to be swept away by this painful situation, but to value your own feelings of what you want to do.

dialogue.origin: どうしたいか、の気持ちですか。彼と会いたい、話したいということでしょうか。その気持ちを大事にするということでしょうか。
dialogue.content: My feelings of what I want to do? Do you mean wanting to see him and talk to him? And to value those feelings?

dialogue.origin: だ連絡を待つしかないのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: So do I just have to wait for him to contact me?

dialogue.origin: 「会いたい」という大事な気持ちを持って、自分は2人の関係のためにやるだけやった、と思えることは、なんでしょうね。待つことでしょうか
dialogue.content: While holding onto that important feeling of 'wanting to see him,' what is something you could do that would make you feel like you've done all you can for the relationship? Would that be waiting?

dialogue.origin: 彼の職場は知ってます。ただ、会いに行こうと思えばいけます。ただこれだけ拒絶されて私の思いだけで会いに行くのは…と考えてしまいます。また、会ったら実は職場のこと仲良くなっているのを目にしたら、と怖くもあります。
dialogue.content: I know where he works. I could go see him if I wanted to. But being rejected this much, I hesitate to go see him based on my feelings alone... I also fear that if I go, I might see him getting close with someone from work.

dialogue.origin: 向こうの気持ちが離れたなら、無理矢理は難しいし、それはいやです。
dialogue.content: If his feelings for me are gone, I can't force it, and I don't want that.

dialogue.origin: 会いに行くことも考えているんですね。
dialogue.content: So you're also considering going to see him.

dialogue.origin: 少し考えましたが、同意の上でなくてはダメだとおもいました。
dialogue.content: I thought about it a little, but I decided it has to be with his consent.

dialogue.origin: たしかに勇気もいるし、不安も緊張も高いですね。
dialogue.content: It certainly would take courage, and the anxiety and tension would be high.

dialogue.origin: はい、あと、卑怯なかんじがして。
dialogue.content: Yes, and it feels sneaky.

dialogue.origin: 卑怯ですか。なるほど。相手の場所に踏み込むことになりますから、その気持ちもわかります。では、会社には行かないとして、他にできることはありますか?LINEは返事がなくても、今、という期間かも知れない、とも考えられませんか?
dialogue.content: 'Sneaky,' I see. It would mean intruding into his space, so I understand that feeling. Then, assuming you won't go to his workplace, is there anything else you could do? Even if there are no replies on LINE, couldn't you think of this as just a 'for now' period?

dialogue.origin: 今という期間、とはどのようなことでしょうか…。
dialogue.content: What do you mean by a 'for now' period...?

dialogue.origin: 「今」というのは、ご家族の病気の期間のことです。
dialogue.content: By 'now,' I mean the period while his family member is ill.

dialogue.origin: 家族の病気がよくなればまた、会えるというのでしょうか？それまでまってみる、ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean that we might be able to see each other again once his family member gets better? So I should try waiting until then?

dialogue.origin: 「病気」と言われているのですから、彼氏さんが落ち着くまで待つことも大事な時間かも知れません。それは、彼氏さんを信じていなければ辛いかも知れませんが
dialogue.content: Since he has told you it's an 'illness,' perhaps waiting until he settles down is an important part of this process. Though that might be difficult if you don't trust him.

dialogue.origin: はい、やはり、まとしかないですかね、信じられるか自身がありませんが…。
dialogue.content: Yes, I guess I have no choice but to wait. I'm not confident I can trust him, though...

dialogue.origin: 連絡のない人を信じるのは、辛いこともあると思います。やはり大事なのは、2人の関係をとうしたいか、という自分の気持ちかも知れません。
dialogue.content: Trusting someone who isn't contacting you can be very painful. Perhaps what's most important are your own feelings about what you want for the relationship.

dialogue.origin: 2人のことをひとりで抱えるのは、辛いと思います。揺れて自信をなくすこともあるかも知れませません。
dialogue.content: I think it's hard to carry the burden of the relationship all by yourself. You might waver and lose confidence at times.

dialogue.origin: どうしたいか。私は彼の今の本心が知りたい。会ったらそれがわかると思う。でも、今は無理に私からはできない。
dialogue.content: What do I want... I want to know what he's really feeling right now. I think I would understand if we met. But right now, I can't force it from my end.

dialogue.origin: 自信はありませんが今は待つしかないのかともおもいます。
dialogue.content: I'm not confident, but I think maybe I have no choice but to wait for now.

dialogue.origin: 今は待つ、ということに決めたんですね。自分の勇気のある決断を大事にしてあげてください。自信満々で待てる人はいないと思います。辛くなったらまたこちらに相談にいらしていただいても大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: So you've decided to wait for now. Please cherish this courageous decision you've made. I don't think anyone could wait with full confidence. If it becomes too difficult, you are always welcome to come back and talk here again.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうしてみます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll try that. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談してみてどうでしたか
dialogue.content: How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.origin: 今の自分の気持ちやできること、できないことが改めてわかりました。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I have a clearer understanding now of my own feelings, and what I can and cannot do. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、お話を聴かせていただいてありがとうございました。気持ちが揺れることもあるでしょうが、応援しています。自分を大事にしてあげてください。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your story with me. Your feelings may waver at times, but I'm rooting for you. Please take care of yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい。まってみます。辛いけど。
dialogue.content: Yes. I'll try waiting. It's hard, though.

dialogue.origin: 〈ロールプレイを終了します〉お疲れ様でした。今日はありがとうございました !
dialogue.content: <Ending the role-play> Thank you for your work today. And thank you for your time!

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much!)

dialogue.origin: (ロールプレイ終了のボタンを押していただけますでしょうか？)
dialogue.content: (Could you please press the button to end the role-play?)

dialogue.origin: すみません、読み返していました。終了します。
dialogue.content: Sorry, I was just rereading our conversation. I will end it now.

topic.sub: 彼氏との連絡不通問題
